items.title: File Widerspruch against rejection of disability pension
items.quote: Gegen diesen Bescheid ist innerhalb eines Monats nach seiner Bekanntgabe der Widerspruch zulässig.
items.computation: Letter is dated 18.11.2026 (Wednesday), no separate 'Tag der Aufgabe zur Post' is stated, so posting day = 18.11.2026. Letters posted on or after 1 Jan 2025 are deemed delivered on the 4th day after posting: 18.11. + 4 days = 22.11.2026 (Sunday). The Rentenversicherung is a social-law body (§ 37 Abs. 2 SGB X applies, not § 108 Abs. 3 AO), so unlike a Finanzamt the delivery day does NOT move to the next working day even though it falls on a Sunday. Bekanntgabe = 22.11.2026. The one-month Widerspruch period (§ 84 SGG / § 37 Abs. 2 SGB X together with §§ 187, 188 BGB) ends on the day in the following month bearing the same number as the delivery day: 22.12.2026 (Tuesday). This day is a regular working day in NRW (not a public holiday), so no further shift under § 26 Abs. 3 SGB X / § 64 Abs. 3 SGG is needed. The Widerspruch must reach the Rentenversicherung by this date.
